chart.title: Order block > delta at price
chart.subtitle: Sellers hit the zone. No break...

caption:
Order blocks don't hold. BUYERS do. 🎯

The bullish order block on NQ sat at 24,396-24,404, the last down candle before the impulse. Price came back and sellers hit the bid hard inside it: 1,390 contracts at three prices in a row, delta -1,205 on the bar. Yet the low barely moved. Passive buyers were absorbing. The next bar flipped: stacked buy imbalances and delta +700, and the rally started. The order block told you where to look. The footprint told you someone was actually defending it.

1️⃣ Order block = a location, not a signal
2️⃣ Heavy selling absorbed + delta flip with stacked buys = the trigger
3️⃣ Sell imbalances and a close below the order block = nobody is defending it, stay out
